entrants.name: Claude Opus
entrants.method: Anthropic frontier model in the uniform harness. MOCK forecasts until an API key is connected.

entrants.name: Climatology (long-run average)
entrants.method: Mean and spread of the last two years of the target series. The 'seasonal average' null borrowed from weather forecasting.

entrants.name: Crowd (pool of all submissions)
entrants.method: Equal-weight mixture of every forecast submitted in the round, scored as one distribution. The community aggregate that individual entrants have to beat.

entrants.name: DeepSeek
entrants.method: DeepSeek frontier model in the uniform harness. MOCK forecasts until an API key is connected.

entrants.name: EWMA (smoothed recent average)
entrants.method: Exponentially weighted moving average of the target series: recent values count more, old values fade out.

entrants.name: Gemini Pro
entrants.method: Google frontier model in the uniform harness. MOCK forecasts until an API key is connected.

entrants.name: GPT-5.5
entrants.method: OpenAI frontier model in the uniform harness: same prompt, temperature 0. MOCK forecasts until an API key is connected.

entrants.name: Grok
entrants.method: xAI frontier model in the uniform harness. MOCK forecasts until an API key is connected.

entrants.name: Human crowd
entrants.method: Pooled guesses from anyone who wants to play: one GitHub issue per guess, aggregated into a single distribution per round.

entrants.name: Persistence (copy last release)
entrants.method: Copies the most recent published value of the target series. The reference null: opinion is close to a random walk.

entrants.name: Qwen
entrants.method: Alibaba frontier model in the uniform harness. MOCK forecasts until an API key is connected.

entrants.name: Linear trend (OLS)
entrants.method: Ordinary least squares straight-line fit over the recent history, extrapolated at most 21 days past the last observation. The classic linear-model baseline.

backtest.note: walk-forward replay on real historical series; each forecast uses only data before its release
